tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Headline, summary, location, current roles, links and what the person with this agentcv handle is open to. Start here.

tools.name: list_experience
tools.description: Approved timeline entries (roles, projects, education, achievements) of the person with this handle, newest first. Filter by kind and by `since` (YYYY or YYYY-MM). Use get_experience with an id for detail.

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Full detail for one entry from list_experience, with supporting source excerpts.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Hybrid semantic + keyword search over the approved source material of the person with this handle. Returns cited passages with source_url and as_of.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Skills of the person with this handle, with evidence: each skill has evidence_count and fact_ids of the entries that support it (pass a fact id to get_experience). Optional query filters by name.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Send an intro request by email to the person with this handle. Call it only when your user has explicitly asked to contact this person in this conversation.
